description: This file defines the ServiceGroupEngine class, which extends the GenericAsyncEngine and provides methods for executing service groups synchronously within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes a constructor for initialization and overrides for runSync and runSyncIgnore methods to handle group service execution with exception handling.

classes.name: ServiceGroupEngine
classes.description: Represents an engine for executing grouped services asynchronously or synchronously, handling group model retrieval and execution within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ServiceGroupEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceGroupEngine with a ServiceDispatcher instance.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service group synchronously, retrieving or loading the GroupModel and invoking its run method. Throws a GenericServiceException if the GroupModel is null.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync to execute a service group without handling exceptions, effectively ignoring them from the caller's perspective.
